newsitem.title: CHINA: SHKP sells 80 pct of Grand Del Sol flats.
newsitem.headline: SHKP sells 80 pct of Grand Del Sol flats.

text.p: Sun Hung Kai Properties Ltd said on Monday it had sold 80 percent of the 730 flats on offer at its Grand Del Sol development in the New Territories on the first sale day on Saturday.
The flats at the residential development in Ha Yau Tin in Yuen Long were offered for sale at an average price of HK$5,100 per square foot.
A total of 2,241 potential buyers had registered to buy the flats at the close of a six-day registration period which ended last week.
The Grand Del Sol development comprises 1,100 units in 13 11-storey residential blocks.
The development is scheduled for completion in October.
